name: Edge Sports
tagline: Sports data, AI prediction estimates and player prop research.
description: Edge Sports is an online sports research platform for comparing available team statistics, matchup context and player prop data. It includes AI prediction estimates, research calculators, saved notes and manual pick tracking, helping users organize their own analysis and review recorded decisions. Check source dates and coverage inside each tool. Free tools and a limited public sample are available alongside optional Premium membership. Coverage varies by sport and source; research does not guarantee results or profit.
